0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Knicks host the 76ers, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives New York a 55% chance to win. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026.
